text: New: a News section with Microsoft 365 changes and retirements (effective dates, why it matters, what to do, primary source) and exploited vulnerabilities, a category filter, a Latest news strip on the homepage and an Atom feed at /news/feed.xml.

New: IT checklists for onboarding, offboarding (planned and immediate) and role changes, with Microsoft Learn links for each Microsoft 365 step, Word and Markdown downloads, and a Policies / Checklists filter on the policy templates page.

New: Policy templates. Ten plain-language IT security policies (acceptable use, password and MFA, BYOD, AI and Copilot, information classification, incident response, backup, access management, patching, third-party security) with placeholders, ISO 27001, NIST CSF 2.0 and CIS v8 references, and Word and Markdown downloads.

New: Security tools & testing. 17 free and open-source tools (domain and mail checks, external exposure, Microsoft 365 and Entra, Active Directory, vulnerability scanning, web apps, Windows hardening, breach exposure), each with a short example, pitfalls and a permission reminder, plus a method for scoping an internal pentest.

One search for everything: instant results for recipes, guides, vulnerabilities, hardening and news, with suggestions as you type, typo tolerance and common questions. Open it from the header on any page or press /.

Security: category filter (Client, Server, Network, Web/Runtime, Virtualization), the vulnerability watch as easy-to-scan cards with a one-line 'What to do', a Patch Tuesday countdown, and four more exploited vulnerabilities (Cisco Secure Email Gateway, Fortinet, Atlassian Data Center, Citrix NetScaler).
Easier reading and finding: search at the top of the homepage with News & retirements and What's new shortcuts, more readable text and spacing across the site, and this What's new page.

Security: eight new exploited vulnerabilities from the CISA KEV catalog: the Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day chain (CVE-2026-104935, CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527), GitLab CI/CD regex RCE (CVE-2026-97229), the Brotli decoder flaw in Node.js and other products (CVE-2026-111497), PAN-OS management RCE (CVE-2026-0322), BeyondTrust Remote Support (CVE-2026-102764), VeloCloud Orchestrator (CVE-2026-114625), Collabora CODE for Nextcloud (CVE-2026-110447) and Adobe Commerce (CVE-2026-48356).

Easier to find, use and share: search and topic filters on the homepage, Start-here cards, Copy steps and Download checklist buttons plus Done-when criteria on every recipe, related recipes and back-to-guide links, a one-page quick guide (5 things to check before assigning Copilot licenses), PDF checklists for both pillar guides, a sample newsletter issue and link-preview images.

Design refresh: consistent page intros, a Verification card at the top of every recipe, guide and security page, numbered steps, pitfall callouts, copy buttons on commands, and an About-the-editor note.

Trust & transparency update: rewritten About page, new Methodology page, this changelog, per-page source and verification panels, "Report an error" links on every page, site-wide search, breadcrumbs, Atom feed and a new footer.
New Cybersecurity section: a vulnerability watch for exploited CVEs and hardening recipes for network, endpoints, servers, services and VMware.
New pillar guide: how to roll out Microsoft Copilot without opening a hole in your tenant (9 phases, printable checklist).
Full fact-check pass of every recipe against current Microsoft Learn pages; 18 recipes corrected.
New homepage, logo and Identity & threat protection track.
Tenant Recipes launched on GitHub Pages.
